description: NASA NAIF SPICE kernels for lunar orientation and time. They define the MOON_ME frame the terrain is in, so Sun/Earth/orbit data from JPL can be converted into it. See docs/CONVENTIONS.md.

files.content: Leap seconds table (UTC <-> TDB). Valid for dates through the next announced leap second; none announced as of 2026-11.
Lunar orientation (libration) over time from DE440, principal-axes frame
Lunar frame definitions; MOON_ME = MOON_ME_DE440_ME421, aligned with the DE421 mean-Earth frame used by the LOLA DEM
